title: ARCADE: OVERSEER SCORES 2,000 FOR PLAYER 2
why: Found by the review of arcade builds 7 to 13. In the arcade the Overseer is worth 2,000, but when player 2 fired the last round his window scored it as a plain warden, 400, because the copy of the body on his window never knew it was the boss. His window now knows the Overseer by its name, as the rest of the party code already does, so the kill is worth 2,000 whoever lands it. Normal raids are untouched.
now: In the arcade the Overseer scores 2,000 for player 2 as it does for the host.

edits.anchor: if(G.arcade) arcadeKill(k,!!(m.el||(e&&e.elite)),!!(e&&e.boss));   // v23.29 (arcade8): the arcade score of player 2
